title: Vectors
subject: Mathematics
subtitle: Class 12 HSC & MHT-CET • Rapid Revision Deck

cards.q: Position vector, magnitude, and unit vector in 3D?
cards.a:
Position vector: r = x i + y j + z k.
Magnitude: |r| = √(x² + y² + z²).
Unit vector: r̂ = r / |r|.
cards.hint: A unit vector always has magnitude |r̂| = 1.

cards.q: Section formula for internal and external division?
cards.a:
Internal division (ratio m : n): r = (m b + n a) / (m + n).
External division (ratio m : n): r = (m b - n a) / (m - n).
cards.hint: m multiplies the farther vector b; n multiplies the nearer vector a.

cards.q: Midpoint and Centroid formulas for triangle and tetrahedron?
cards.a:
Midpoint: m = (a + b) / 2.
Centroid of ΔABC: g = (a + b + c) / 3.
Centroid of tetrahedron ABCD: g = (a + b + c + d) / 4.
cards.hint: Centroid divides each median in the ratio 2 : 1.

cards.q: Formula for Incentre of triangle ABC?
cards.a: Incentre i = (a a + b b + c c) / (a + b + c), where a, b, c are lengths of sides opposite to vertices A, B, C.
cards.hint: Side lengths act as the weights for the corresponding opposite vertex vectors.

cards.q: Definition and component formula for Dot (Scalar) Product?
cards.a: a · b = |a| |b| cos θ = a₁ b₁ + a₂ b₂ + a₃ b₃.
cards.hint: Scalar product is commutative: a · b = b · a.

cards.q: Condition for two non-zero vectors a and b to be perpendicular (orthogonal)?
cards.a: a · b = 0  (i.e. a₁ b₁ + a₂ b₂ + a₃ b₃ = 0).
cards.hint: Zero dot product ⇔ perpendicular vectors.

cards.q: Scalar projection and Vector projection of a on b?
cards.a:
Scalar projection: (a · b) / |b|.
Vector projection: [ (a · b) / |b|² ] · b.
cards.hint: The projection is ON vector b, so |b| is always in the denominator.

cards.q: Definition and determinant form for Vector (Cross) Product?
cards.a: a × b = (|a| |b| sin θ) n̂ = | [i, j, k], [a₁, a₂, a₃], [b₁, b₂, b₃] |.
cards.hint: Anti-commutative: b × a = -(a × b). Cross product produces a vector perpendicular to both a and b.

cards.q: Condition for two non-zero vectors a and b to be collinear (parallel)?
cards.a: a × b = 0  (or a = k b, meaning a₁/b₁ = a₂/b₂ = a₃/b₃).
cards.hint: Zero cross product ⇔ parallel/collinear vectors.

cards.q: Unit vector perpendicular to both vectors a and b?
cards.hint: Always include ± unless a specific orientation/sense is specified.

cards.q: Area of Parallelogram with adjacent sides vs diagonals?
cards.a:
With adjacent sides a and b: Area = |a × b|.
With diagonals d₁ and d₂: Area = (1/2) |d₁ × d₂|.
cards.hint: Be careful: using diagonals requires an extra factor of 1/2!

cards.q: Area of Triangle ABC with position vectors a, b, c?
cards.hint: Three points A, B, C are collinear ⇔ a × b + b × c + c × a = 0.

cards.q: Definition and determinant form of Scalar Triple Product (Box Product)?
cards.a: [a b c] = a · (b × c) = | [a₁, a₂, a₃], [b₁, b₂, b₃], [c₁, c₂, c₃] |.
cards.hint: Dot and cross can be interchanged: a · (b × c) = (a × b) · c.

cards.q: Cyclic and anti-cyclic properties of Box Product [a b c]?
cards.a:
[a b c] = [b c a] = [c a b] = -[b a c] = -[a c b] = -[c b a].
Also [a a b] = 0 (if any two vectors are identical or parallel, box product is 0).
cards.hint: Cyclic order preserves value; swapping any two vectors flips the sign.

cards.q: Condition for three vectors a, b, c to be coplanar?
cards.hint: Four points A, B, C, D are coplanar ⇔ [AB AC AD] = 0.

cards.q: Volume of Parallelopiped and Volume of Tetrahedron?
cards.a:
Volume of parallelopiped with coterminous edges a, b, c: V = |[a b c]|.
Volume of tetrahedron ABCD: V = (1/6) |[AB AC AD]|.
cards.hint: Tetrahedron volume is 1/6 times the volume of the corresponding parallelopiped.

cards.q: State Lagrange's Identity relating dot and cross products.
cards.a: |a × b|² + (a · b)² = |a|² |b|².
cards.hint: Direct proof: |a|² |b|² sin² θ + |a|² |b|² cos² θ = |a|² |b|².

cards.q: Value of [a + b, b + c, c + a] in terms of [a b c]?
cards.a: [a + b, b + c, c + a] = 2 [a b c].
cards.hint: Classic MHT-CET question! Always equals exactly 2 times [a b c].

cards.q: Value of [a - b, b - c, c - a]?
cards.hint: Vectors (a - b), (b - c), (c - a) are always coplanar since their sum is zero!

cards.q: Vector Triple Product expansion formula?
cards.a: a × (b × c) = (a · c) b - (a · b) c.
cards.hint: Mnemonic: 'BAC minus CAB' rule.

cards.q: Work done and Torque (moment of a force) in vector form?
cards.a:
Work done: W = F · d (scalar product of force and displacement).
Torque: τ = r × F (vector product of position vector and force).
cards.hint: Torque is about a point: r = r_point_of_action - r_moment_centre.

cards.q: If |a + b| = |a - b|, what is the geometric relation between a and b?
cards.a: Vectors a and b are perpendicular (orthogonal), i.e. a · b = 0.
cards.hint: Square both sides: |a|² + |b|² + 2 a · b = |a|² + |b|² - 2 a · b ⇒ 4 a · b = 0 ⇒ a · b = 0.

cards.q: If |a + b| = |a| + |b|, what is the geometric relation between a and b?
cards.a: Vectors a and b are collinear and point in the same direction (θ = 0°).
cards.hint: Triangle inequality equality condition: vectors are parallel and like-directed.

cards.q: Value of i · (j × k) + j · (k × i) + k · (i × j)?
cards.hint: j × k = i, k × i = j, i × j = k.

cards.q: Value of (a × b)² in determinant form?
cards.a: |a × b|² = | [a · a, a · b], [a · b, b · b] | = |a|² |b|² - (a · b)².
cards.hint: Determinant form of Cauchy-Schwarz / Lagrange identity.
